title: Sandbox placeholder files never count as a lane's changes
body:
Why: outside rerun 1115h2: empty sandbox placeholders (.env*, .npmrc, ...) in the lane worktree count as changed files, so the characterization mode from 66ff932 never applies (src/hook/stop.ts:249-256 and 749-755; /mnt/storage/coding/krn/active/krn/.krn/runs/outside/php.log:631); php plain row drained 73.
Outcome: the changed-file set used by every Stop arm and by the proof line excludes the placeholders src/state/sandbox-placeholders.ts creates (one shared source of the list); a tests-only diff with placeholders present is characterization.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/state/sandbox-placeholders.ts, tests.
Proof: a Stop test on the verbatim php.log:631 situation (tests-only diff plus empty placeholders) passes red-first in characterization mode and is red without the fix.
